articles.description: Sullivan is more Ned Flanders than Ned Yost. A decade as a mascot for Mapquest could have made him bitter. Instead, it made him better, hungrier, and oddly, happier.

articles.title: Rumfield and Amador homer as Rockies stop 10-game home skid with 4-2 win over Orioles
articles.description: TJ Rumfield broke a seventh-inning tie with a two-run homer and the Colorado Rockies beat the Baltimore Orioles 4-2 on Tuesday night to snap their franchise-record home losing streak at 10 games.
